# Get songs from library
songs_response = apis.Spotify.get_songs(access_token=token, page_index=0)
print(f"Songs in library (first page): {len(songs_response['songs'])} songs")
print(f"Total songs: {songs_response['total']}")

# Collect all songs
all_songs = set()
for song in songs_response['songs']:
    all_songs.add(song['id'])

# Paginate through all songs
page_index = 1
while len(all_songs) < songs_response['total']:
    songs_response = apis.Spotify.get_songs(access_token=token, page_index=page_index)
    for song in songs_response['songs']:
        all_songs.add(song['id'])
    page_index += 1

print(f"Total unique songs from songs library: {len(all_songs)}")
</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>
<function_calls>
<invoke name="python">
<parameter name="code">
# Get albums from library
albums_response = apis.Spotify.get_albums(access_token=token, page_index=0)
print(f"Albums in library (first page): {len(albums_response['albums'])} albums")
print(f"Total albums: {albums_response['total']}")

# Collect all album songs
album_songs_count = 0
page_index = 0
while True:
    albums_response = apis.Spotify.get_albums(access_token=token, page_index=page_index)
    if not albums_response['albums']:
        break
    for album in albums_response['albums']:
        # Get songs from each album
        album_tracks_response = apis.Spotify.get_album_songs(access_token=token, album_id=album['id'], page_index=0)
        for song in album_tracks_response['songs']:
            if song['id'] not in all_songs:
                all_songs.add(song['id'])
                album_songs_count += 1
        
        # Paginate through album songs
        album_page = 1
        while len(album_tracks_response['songs']) > 0:
            album_tracks_response = apis.Spotify.get_album_songs(access_token=token, album_id=album['id'], page_index=album_page)
            for song in album_tracks_response['songs']:
                if song['id'] not in all_songs:
                    all_songs.add(song['id'])
                    album_songs_count += 1
            album_page += 1
    page_index += 1

print(f"New unique songs from albums: {album_songs_count}")
print(f"Total unique songs so far: {len(all_songs)}")
</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>
<function_calls>
<invoke name="python">

# Get playlists
playlists_response = apis.Spotify.get_playlists(access_token=token, page_index=0)
print(f"Playlists (first page): {len(playlists_response['playlists'])} playlists")
print(f"Total playlists: {playlists_response['total']}")

# Collect all playlist songs
playlist_songs_count = 0
page_index = 0
while True:
    playlists_response = apis.Spotify.get_playlists(access_token=token, page_index=page_index)
    if not playlists_response['playlists']:
        break
    for playlist in playlists_response['playlists']:
        # Get songs from each playlist
        playlist_tracks_response = apis.Spotify.get_playlist_songs(access_token=token, playlist_id=playlist['id'], page_index=0)
        for song in playlist_tracks_response['songs']:
            if song['id'] not in all_songs:
                all_songs.add(song['id'])
                playlist_songs_count += 1
        
        # Paginate through playlist songs
        playlist_page = 1
        while len(playlist_tracks_response['songs']) > 0:
            playlist_tracks_response = apis.Spotify.get_playlist_songs(access_token=token, playlist_id=playlist['id'], page_index=playlist_page)
            for song in playlist_tracks_response['songs']:
                if song['id'] not in all_songs:
                    all_songs.add(song['id'])
                    playlist_songs_count += 1
            playlist_page += 1
    page_index += 1

print(f"New unique songs from playlists: {playlist_songs_count}")
print(f"Total unique songs across all sources: {len(all_songs)}")
</parameter>
</invoke>

    # Extract file extension
    file_name = metadata['name']
    name_parts = file_name.rsplit('.', 1)
    if len(name_parts) == 2:
        base_name, ext = name_parts
        new_name = f"{date_prefix}_{base_name}.{ext}"
    else:

    # Rename the file
    apis.file_system.rename_file(file_path=file['path'], new_name=new_name)
